info.title: Live Web Data API
info.summary: Live web pages as clean Markdown, text or HTML for AI agents.
info.description:
Fetch public web pages through our fetch network and get clean Markdown, text or HTML back.

Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`.

**Per-URL errors** (HTTP 200, in `statuses[].error.tag`, 0 credits): `CRAWL_NOT_FOUND`, `SOURCE_NOT_AVAILABLE`, `CRAWL_LIVECRAWL_TIMEOUT`, `CRAWL_NOT_RENDERED`, `UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE`, `CRAWL_UNKNOWN_ERROR`, `SOURCE_BLOCKED`, `BROWSER_UNAVAILABLE`, `RATE_LIMITED`, and `RESTRICTED_TARGET` for blocked URLs inside a multi-URL request.

Up to 10 URLs per request; rate limits count URLs.

post.description:
Fetch 1–10 URLs live and return clean content. HTTP 200 even if individual URLs failed — check `statuses[]`.

A fetch still running after about 100 seconds answers **202** instead: send the same request again with the `Idempotency-Key` from that answer (after `Retry-After` seconds) to get the result. A repeat is not charged again. Results are kept for 15 minutes; a result nobody collects stays charged. Always send your own `Idempotency-Key`: a connection cut after the API received the request (a network error, a timeout, a deploy) can then be retried with the same key without a second charge.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Your id for this request, 8–128 characters of `A–Z a–z 0–9 _ - : .`. A repeat with the same key and the same body returns the same result instead of fetching (and charging) again, for 24 hours; with a different body it answers 409. Without it, the API creates one and returns it in the `Idempotency-Key` response header.

200.description: Processed. One status per URL; successful pages in results.

X-Request-Id.description: Same as requestId in the body.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: URLs you can send at once (bucket size, = rateLimit.burst in GET /v1/account). The bucket refills at rateLimit.requestsPerSecond URLs per second.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: URLs you can send right now.

Idempotency-Key.description: The request's Idempotency-Key: yours, or one the API created when you sent none. On every answer (200, 202, errors) except a 400 for a malformed key and a 413 for a body over 10 MiB (refused unread). Repeat a 202 with it.

202.description: Still fetching after about 100 seconds. Send the same request again with this Idempotency-Key after Retry-After seconds; the repeat waits for the result and is not charged again.

X-Request-Id.description: Same as requestId in the body.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait: before retrying a 429, or before repeating a 202 with the same Idempotency-Key.

urls.description: Pages to fetch (1–10), each at most 8,192 characters. Processed in parallel; one entry per URL in statuses. Duplicates (same URL, ignoring #fragment) are fetched once; repeated positions cost 0 credits.

countryCode.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country to fetch from. Default "us".

maxCharacters.description: Truncate text and markdown to this many characters. Default 100000. results[].textTruncated tells you when it did.

maxAgeHours.description: Accepted only as 0 (for older clients): there is no cache, every request is fetched live.

html.description: Include the page HTML as served in results[].html. Default false. A response carries at most 24 MiB of JSON: past that, the remaining results come without html (warning RESPONSE_SIZE_LIMIT).

livecrawlTimeout.description: Live fetch timeout in ms (1–90000). Default 60000, and a value below 30000 is raised to 30000 (the browser fallback needs it); with renderFallback: false any value, default 10000; with render or renderFallback: true at least 30000, default 60000.

render.description: Render every URL in a real browser, as a normal visitor sees it (3 credits, 5 when the page needed a retry through another connection). Cannot be combined with renderFallback. Default false.

renderFallback.description: Fetch normally first; render in a real browser only when the first attempt did not return the page or shows no or very little visible text. On by default (omit it); false = plain fetch only, never a browser. A normal success costs its normal credits, a rendered one only the render credits. Cannot be combined with render: true.

results.description: One entry per successfully fetched URL.

title.description: At most 2,000 characters (cut with an ellipsis).

author.description: At most 2,000 characters (cut with an ellipsis).

image.description: null when the page names none, or a URL longer than 4,096 characters.

favicon.description: The page's icon, else /favicon.ico of its origin (an icon URL longer than 4,096 characters is not used).

text.description: Plain text, tags removed, whitespace normalized.

html.description: Page HTML as served. Only with html: true, and only while the response stays within its 24 MiB size limit (else warning RESPONSE_SIZE_LIMIT).

textTruncated.description: true when text or markdown was cut at text.maxCharacters, or at the response size limit (warning RESPONSE_SIZE_LIMIT). Present whenever text is enabled.

warnings.description: Absent when empty. "PAGE_TRUNCATED" = only part of the page could be retrieved; "THIN_CONTENT" = the page probably needs render: true; "EXTRACTION_FALLBACK" = converted as plain text (too complex in time); "RESPONSE_SIZE_LIMIT" = the response reached its 24 MiB size limit, so this result has no html (and maybe cut text/markdown).

source.description: Always "livecrawled" on success (there is no cache); null on error.

fetchedAt.description: When the page was fetched (ISO 8601); null on error.

strategy.description: "fast" = standard fetch (1 credit). "retry" = the first attempt did not return the page, a retry through another connection did (2 credits). "browser" = rendered in a real browser, as a normal visitor sees it (3 credits, 5 when it needed a retry through another connection). "local-browser" is reserved.

credits.description: Credits charged for this URL: 1 standard, 2 retried, 3 rendered, 5 rendered + retried, 0 on error and for a short page delivered with thin: true (a success, not an error).

fallbackUsed.description: Present (true) only when the browser fallback ran for this URL: with strategy "browser" the content is that render (fast → render); with another strategy, or on error, rendering was tried and did not help.

thin.description: Present (true) only for a short page delivered at 0 credits: fewer than 500 characters of visible text even after rendering. The result holds only that visible text. A success, not an error.

nextResetAt.description: Free test, 402 only: when this week's credits come back (Monday 00:00 UTC).

freeTierEnded.description: Free test, 402 only: true once the 4 weeks are over.

upgradeUrl.description: Free test, 402 only: where to choose a plan.

requestId.description: Same for every repeat with the same Idempotency-Key.

idempotencyKey.description: Send the same request again with this Idempotency-Key header.

retryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before repeating (also the Retry-After header).

plan.description: Plan id, e.g. "starter" ("trial" before a plan is activated).

status.description: Account status, e.g. active, pending_review, suspended.

requestsPerSecond.description: Refill rate: URLs per second, sustained.

burst.description: Bucket size: URLs you can send at once. Same number as the X-RateLimit-Limit header.

periodEndsAt.description: End of the current billing period (ISO 8601).

eligible.description: false: this sign-up was refused free credits; choose a paid plan to continue.

week.description: Current free week, 1–4; null after the end or when not eligible.

weeks.description: Length of the free test in weeks (4).

creditsPerWeek.description: This week's grant: 100 in week 1, then 50. Credits left = credits.plan.

nextResetAt.description: Next weekly grant, Monday 00:00 UTC; null in the last week, after the end or when not eligible.

endsAt.description: End of the free test (after the 4th week).
